rca_of_the_issue: Original user error 'npm error ENOENT .../backend/package.json' was caused by Render being pointed at the Python backend/ folder as a Node service. Fix (render.yaml with rootDir: frontend, plus RENDER_DEPLOY.md) directs Render to the Next.js frontend/ folder which contains package.json and serves everything on a single port. Verified end-to-end by simulating Render's build+start commands locally on PORT=10077 with all critical endpoints returning expected responses.
